title: Small-business support grants
summary: Grants to established local shops toward rent, payroll and upgrades.

how: Town staff design the grant program and propose its budget.
Residents comment at a public hearing on the budget.
Town Council votes on the budget that funds the grants.

evidence.claim: Most incentives change only 2-25% of recipients' decisions
evidence.source: Bartik (2018), "But For" Percentages for Economic Development Incentives, Upjohn Institute

evidence.claim: Storefront businesses close at roughly 8-13% a year

pros: Some storefronts that would otherwise close stay open, keeping their jobs and foot traffic.
cons: Paid from the Town budget, as grants of $10,000.
Most grants go to businesses that would have stayed open anyway: incentives change 2-25% of recipients' decisions in the studies cited.
